roles.authority: technical containment and recovery owner within existing access
merchant operations owner; communications require separate approval; not engineering QA
preserves immutable timeline and evidence references

severity.definition: confirmed cross-tenant exposure, signing-key compromise, or uncontrolled production money/stock mutation
credible credential compromise, fraudulent correction authority, or unavailable recovery for an active merchant
contained security defect or service degradation with a safe workaround and no confirmed cross-tenant effect

systems.recoveryEvidence: named staff identity and MFA missing
append-only source tests PASS; hosted restore NOT RUN

scenarios.detect: unexpected authenticated session, secret alert, or provider access event
contain: revoke the exact affected session or credential
preserve other identities and customer data
block new privileged actions until scope is known
recover: rotate only the affected credential through its owner procedure
review actions during the exposure window

scenarios.detect: one actor can observe another workspace or cross-tenant identifier
contain: disable the affected hosted route or membership
keep unaffected local selling available where safe
recover: run two-tenant denial and revocation proof
forbidden: copy exposed data into a bug report

scenarios.detect: invalid, replayed, foreign-workspace, or unexplained correction authorization
contain: disable correction issuance while normal offline selling remains available
preserve original sale and audit records
recover: reconcile stock, cash shift and wallet uncertainty
prove forged, replayed and wrong-scope denial
forbidden: claim a wallet refund without provider evidence

scenarios.detect: merchant reports a missing or stolen device holding Shop records
contain: revoke hosted sessions and memberships associated with the device
do not remotely claim local data deletion
record last known backup and close state
recover: install only an approved signed build
reconcile post-backup records with the merchant
forbidden: request the backup passphrase in chat

scenarios.detect: encrypted backup fails integrity, migration, workspace binding, or reopen verification
contain: preserve the original archive and source database
stop replacement of the current database
recover: use an independently verified prior backup
repair migration only with synthetic reproduction
repeat restore in an isolated target before merchant use

scenarios.detect: unexpected signature, custody breach, or unauthorized signed artifact
contain: preserve artifact, signature and release metadata
notify platform owners through approved channels
recover: revoke or rotate through the platform owner procedure
publish a reviewed replacement only after independent verification
